items.title: Sky Crew Aviation HD
items.creator: LinsCraft
items.description:
Join the sky crew and reach beyond the clouds! Take off into the blue sky and travel across the world with unstoppable enthusiasm! 

This pack includes:
- 1 free skin. 
- 15 sky crew-inspired skins. 

Made by LinsCraft.

items.title: Bedwars Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like anime characters and playing bedwars? Then this pack is for you! Put on your best Bedwars outfits and get ready to do PvP, PvE and fights.
The bed war is waiting for you!

+ 12 Bedwars Anime skins

items.title: Fantastic Mountainside Base
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Live in complete harmony with nature and embrace the wonderful view on your fantastic mountainside base!

- Refreshing survival base!
- Huge structure to explore!
- Peaceful and refreshing atmosphere!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Toy Store Plushies 2
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
We're back again with your favorite plushie pals! With this skin pack you can choose between ten updated characters, each one puffed and stuffed with pixelie cuteness. Only you can make these toys come to life!

*10 skins not found in the previous pack, like the panda, bee, piglin, ocelot and more!
*Includes 1 free skin

items.title: CITY BUNDLE
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
The BIGGEST city expansion pack on the Marketplace! (Includes 4x worlds)

+ FURNITURE OPTIONS (540+)
+ ANIMALS + PETS
+ DRAGON CITY (MANY DRAGONS!)
+ CUSTOM DUNGEONS 
+ VEHICLES (25+)
+ MODERN + FOREST + MEDIEVAL + MILLIONAIRE (WORLD)

items.title: Cyberblocks 2.0
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
With all new designs, the Cyberblocks 2.0 skin set is here! More colorful designs straight out of the digital world!

- 8 unique skins!
- Wild geometric patterns!

items.title: Rich
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Capture the millionaire aesthetic with this flashy skin pack. Sit back and host a party at your mansion or mingle with society. The choice is yours.

items.title: Horror Show HD
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the show! Give terror a name with these horrifying skins of monsters renowned for their ghastly appearance. Hide around a corner or behind a door and give your friends a proper fright.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Glasses
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Your skin is a part of who you are so make it more like yourself with these stylish teens wearing glasses. You can choose from eight different styles.

items.title: Axolotl Agents
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
These axolotl agents are ready to fight modern day crime and take action! With these colorful agents, you and your friends can solve the most difficult mysteries and discover hidden secrets! Pick your favorite colored axolotl agent that best suits you!

- 9 stylish axolotl agents!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Chic Fashionistas
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
New rules mean a new way of living! Dive into the deep ocean of fashion, full of possibilities and swim as hard as you can to achieve your dreams. Trendy waves are overflowing in this town, and all the people can't wait for you to hit the streets with your latest urban wares!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Tree House Secret Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description:
Live in a sweet home hidden by a giant tree! Discover all it's secrets and rooms.
+ Include loot chests.

items.title: Treasure Island
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: An old mysterious island, what has to be find there? Treasures? If you are unlucky maybe a dangerous cave!

items.title: Pancakes
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up as one of the most beloved breakfast foods!

+ 7 wild pancake skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: BANANAS!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
The year is 4823, and after a major advancement in scientific technology, bananas have been able to develop minds of their own. Little did the humans know that the war of bananas would take place, ending with these yellow fruit conquering the planet. Now humans live in fear, watching the bananas evolve even further day by day.

+ 7 cool banana skins
+ Funny outfits!

items.title: Perfect Pinks
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to dress up in a variety of cool pink outfits!

+ 12 teenage skins
+ Stylish pink outfits

items.title: Knight Warfare
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Get ready for an all-out fight, pick your faction and equip your sword.

-10 knight heroes

items.title: Glowing Creepers
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: What's scarier than regular creepers? Creepers that are glowing! Choose from these 8 colorful and cool-looking skins. Which one is your favorite?

items.title: Cave Disguise
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Blend into the terrain or troll your friends with these camouflaged skins!

items.title: Millionaire Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a millionaire teen! Live in your next mansion in style with the Millionaire Teens skin pack!

+ 10 millionaire teen skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: MEGA RICH MANSION
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Upgrade to a million dollar MEGA RICH MANSION! Drive fast cars, explore the giant mansion and live the good life in this amazing world!
This world is perfect for survival or roleplaying.

- Includes cars
- This world is made for roleplaying

items.title: ONE BLOCK [?]

items.description:
One block + Lucky Block = ONE BLOCK [?]

+ 1.20 blocks
+ Sky block challenge
+ Search lucky blocks one by one

items.title: FURNITURE Roleplay World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Welcome to this furniture roleplay world! Customize your house or neighborhood with amazing furniture to choose from. Furniture is great to build with and roleplay!

items.title: Luxury Mob Style
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Join a group of the best dressed teen mobs and shine! These outfits include luxurious hoodies, expensive shoes and trendy accessories to help impress your friends. Become the most fashionable mob in your Minecraft world!

+ 1 FREE skin
+ Luxury fashion
